Container.Name: burner-matrix
Container.Overview: Internal field-sales burner selection matrix for Beckett and Wayne (incl. Comet) oil and gas burners, with a sign-in admin screen at /admin for editing burners. Burner data, uploaded photos, users and change history live in the appdata folder.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Burner list, uploaded photos, users and change history. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: First admin username
Config.Description: Creates the first admin the first time the container starts. Add more people later in /admin.

Config.Name: First admin password
Config.Description: 8+ characters. Only used once, to create the first admin. Change it afterwards in /admin.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for the nightly 1:00 a.m. backup and dates. Unraid usually fills this in for you.

Config.Name: Send RFQs to
Config.Description: Default address(es) the Email PDF button sends RFQs to. Comma-separate several. Reps can change it per RFQ.

Config.Name: SMTP server
Config.Description: Outgoing mail server, e.g. smtp.gmail.com or smtp.office365.com

Config.Name: SMTP username
Config.Description: Usually the full email address of the sending account

Config.Name: SMTP password
Config.Description: For Gmail, an App Password (Google account, Security, App passwords), not your normal password

Config.Name: Send from address
Config.Description: Leave blank to use the SMTP username. Gmail only allows your own address.

Config.Name: Notification contact
Config.Description: Optional. A mailto: or https: contact sent to Apple/Google with phone notifications. Defaults to the Send from address.

Config.Name: HTTPS-only cookies
Config.Description: Set true if you only open it over https://

Config.Name: Behind reverse proxy
Config.Description: Set true behind Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG or a Cloudflare tunnel.
